test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the part containing a grammatical or structural error:

The teacher advised to listen attentively.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in the phrase **"to listen attentively."**
 
• The verb **"advised"** requires an object, and the correct construction is **"The teacher advised [someone] to listen attentively."**
 
• Simply using "advised to" without specifying the object is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 1**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The teacher advised the students to listen attentively."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: "No error" – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 1.
 
• **Option 3: "The teacher"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "advised"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
